title: Rosello et Fils
description: Rosello & Fils is a fruit and vegetable wholesaler based in Saint-Laurent-Blangy, France. With over 100 years of experience, the company operates exclusively within the Hauts-de-France region, serving professionals in the Nord, Pas-de-Calais, and Somme departments. Its client base includes commercial and collective catering, local shops, and large and medium-sized retail surfaces
